name: Miracles
overview: Scripture reveals God's sovereign power over creation and human history through miraculous acts, such as the unity of language at the world's beginning, the divine presence symbolized by a smoking furnace and burning lamp, and the miraculous conception of Isaac in old age. These miracles demonstrate God's ability to intervene supernaturally, as seen in the transformation of Lot's wife into a pillar of salt and the healing of Abimelech's household, affirming His control over life and judgment. Such events underscore the trustworthiness of God's promises and His active involvement in the unfolding of His redemptive plan.
